statements.status_notes: PingFederate is not affected by any of these Jettison advisories, because Jettison is not shipped with the product. A Jettison artifact appears only as a compile-time ("provided") transitive dependency of a legacy Jersey JSON module used by the SDK build; it is never packaged into the PingFederate distribution, and no Jettison classes are present in any shipped jar. Scanner findings against PingFederate for these advisories should be dismissed as artifacts absent from the product. No customer action is required.
